athkar.title: Daily Athkar
athkar.subtitle: Morning • Evening • Sleep • After Prayer
athkar.tapToContinue: Tap anywhere for the next dhikr
athkar.morning_1_benefit: Whoever recites it in the morning is protected from jinn until evening, and whoever recites it in the evening is protected until morning.
athkar.morning_2_benefit: Whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening, it will suffice them from everything.
athkar.morning_7_benefit: Whoever says it with conviction in the evening and dies that night enters Paradise, and likewise in the morning.
athkar.morning_8_benefit: Whoever says it four times in the morning or evening, Allah frees them from the Fire.
athkar.morning_9_benefit: Whoever says it in the morning has fulfilled the gratitude for the day, and in the evening for the night.
athkar.morning_11_benefit: Whoever says it seven times in the morning and evening, Allah suffices them in all matters of this world and the Hereafter.
athkar.morning_14_benefit: Whoever says it three times in the morning and evening, nothing will harm them.
athkar.morning_15_benefit: Whoever says it three times in the morning and evening, it is upon Allah to please them on the Day of Judgment.
athkar.morning_19_benefit: His sins are shed even if they are like the foam of the sea, and no one comes on the Day of Judgment with anything better except one who said the same or more.
athkar.morning_20_benefit: It is as if he freed four slaves from the children of Ishmael, ten good deeds are written for him, ten bad deeds are erased, and he is raised ten degrees.
athkar.morning_22_benefit: Recommended to say after Fajr prayer.
athkar.morning_24_benefit: Whoever sends blessings upon me ten times in the morning and evening, my intercession reaches them on the Day of Judgment.
athkar.evening_1_benefit: Whoever recites it in the morning is protected from jinn until evening, and whoever recites it in the evening is protected until morning.
athkar.evening_2_benefit: Whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening, it will suffice them from everything.
athkar.evening_7_benefit: Whoever says it with conviction in the evening and dies that night enters Paradise, and likewise in the morning.
athkar.evening_8_benefit: Whoever says it four times in the morning or evening, Allah frees them from the Fire.
athkar.evening_9_benefit: Whoever says it in the morning has fulfilled the gratitude for the day, and in the evening for the night.
athkar.evening_11_benefit: Whoever says it seven times in the morning and evening, Allah suffices them in all matters of this world and the Hereafter.
athkar.evening_14_benefit: Whoever says it three times in the morning and evening, nothing will harm them.
athkar.evening_15_benefit: Whoever says it three times in the morning and evening, it is upon Allah to please them on the Day of Judgment.
athkar.evening_19_benefit: His sins are shed even if they are like the foam of the sea, and no one comes on the Day of Judgment with anything better except one who said the same or more.
athkar.evening_20_benefit: It is as if he freed four slaves from the children of Ishmael, ten good deeds are written for him, ten bad deeds are erased, and he is raised ten degrees.
athkar.evening_21_benefit: Whoever says it three times in the evening, no poisonous creature will harm them that night.
athkar.evening_22_benefit: Whoever sends blessings upon me ten times in the morning and evening, my intercession reaches them on the Day of Judgment.
athkar.sleep_2_benefit: You will have a protector from Allah, and no devil will come near you until morning.
athkar.sleep_3_source: Last two verses of Al-Baqarah - Al-Bukhari and Muslim
athkar.sleep_3_benefit: Whoever recites them at night, they will suffice them.
athkar.sleep_6_benefit: Said when placing the right hand under the cheek.
athkar.sleep_8_benefit: Whoever says it before sleep, it is better for them than a servant.
athkar.sleep_13_benefit: If you die, you die upon the natural faith (fitrah).
athkar.prayer_1_benefit: Said immediately after the obligatory prayer's taslim
athkar.prayer_3_title: None Has the Right to Be Worshipped but Allah
athkar.prayer_5_benefit: Sins are forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea
athkar.prayer_8_benefit: Said once to complete 100, after the 33+33+33
athkar.prayer_9_benefit: Nothing stands between the one who recites it after every prayer and entering Paradise except death

about.title: About
about.tagline: A minimal, ad-free Quran reading experience designed for focus and reflection.
about.whatIsThisText: Quran App is a clean, distraction-free platform for reading the Holy Quran. Built with simplicity in mind, it offers a focused reading experience without ads, popups, or unnecessary features.
about.feature1: Complete Quran with 114 surahs in Uthmani script
about.feature2: Daily Athkar — morning, evening, and sleep supplications
about.feature3: Page break indicators for traditional reading
about.feature4: Adjustable font size and reading settings
about.update1: Athkar progress now saves and resets daily
about.update2: Auto-advance to next thikr on completion
about.update4: Improved Arabic phrasing in athkar texts
about.update5: Installable as a PWA with offline support
about.update6: Verse sharing with WhatsApp image generation

footer.tagline: A minimal, ad-free Quran reading experience built for focus and reflection.
